name: Machine Grip Squeeze
steps: Set up at the grip machine with both hands around the fixed and moving bars.
Rest your thumbs on the upper bar, curl your fingers under the lower handle and keep your wrists straight.
Squeeze your fingers firmly upward to close the moving handle against the stationary bar, contracting your forearm flexors tightly.
Open your fingers slowly under control to lower the moving handle back to the starting width.
tips: Control the opening phase slowly rather than letting the lever snap your fingers open.
Avoid jerking your shoulders or body weight to help squeeze the handles together.
